site.name: המשך תנועה
site.description: המשך תנועה is an Israeli nonprofit building a nationwide network of local community centers, with regular activities for combat veterans after their service: room to meet, move, find direction and build a good life.
site.ogImageAlt: The המשך תנועה mark and name above the Hebrew line “Service ends. The team doesn’t have to.”, beige on navy.

footer.about: המשך תנועה is a home for combat veterans after their service: regular meetings built on movement, community and direction — and, on the way, local community centers across Israel.
